parameters.name: AdminRamId
parameters.description: The list of administrator IDs for the call center instance to create. If this parameter is not specified, the user who performs the creation operation is designated as the call center administrator by default.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the call center instance to create.

parameters.name: DirectoryId
parameters.description: The directory service ID, which is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The second-level domain name of the call center instance to create. The domain name must be globally unique.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the call center instance to create. The name must be unique within the account.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number used by the call center for external services.

parameters.name: PhoneNumbers
parameters.description: The list of phone numbers to add to the call center.

parameters.name: StorageMaxDays
parameters.description: The maximum number of days that recording files can be stored.

parameters.name: StorageMaxSize
parameters.description: The maximum storage capacity for recording files. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: UserObject
parameters.description: Creates multiple users when creating the call center.
